# Skyes Over London Staffing

Skyes Over London Staffing is a staffing, recruiting, workforce operations, AE-powered account growth, and government-ready workforce support brand.

Core services:
- Temporary staffing
- Temp-to-hire
- Direct placement
- Project crew staffing
- Administrative staffing
- Customer service staffing
- Warehouse and logistics staffing
- Sales support staffing
- Government staff augmentation
- Prime-contractor subcontracting support

Government contracting posture:
- The website includes capability statement and NAICS candidate content.
- The company should not claim UEI, CAGE, SAM registration, set-aside certifications, GSA Schedule, bonding, insurance, or past federal performance unless verified.
- Government pages are written for agencies, municipalities, and prime contractors that need workforce support.

Contact:
- Email: SkyesOverLondonLC@solenterprises.org


Additional site surfaces:
- Jobs board shell
- Candidate application
- Employer portal preview
- Engagement model / quote page
- Contact hub
- FAQ
- Privacy and terms placeholders
- Government opportunity tracker
- Arizona service-area pages for Phoenix, Glendale, Mesa, Tempe, Scottsdale, and Chandler
- Additional long-form staffing articles about job orders, prime contractor staffing support, quality control, and Arizona staffing strategy

Important limitations:
- Static forms need Netlify Forms or a backend to receive submissions.
- Candidate file upload is not implemented in this static package.
- Employer portal is a preview shell, not a secure authenticated portal.
- Government opportunity tracker is static/internal and should not expose sensitive pursuit notes.


Sales and operations expansion:
- proposal-builder.html for internal client proposal intake
- case-studies.html for verified proof and public case-study shells
- ae-recruiting.html for Account Executive recruiting
- sales-scripts.html for internal AE sales scripts
- candidate-onboarding.html for candidate readiness
- procurement-packet.html for government/prime buyer packet organization
- quality-control-plan.html for staffing quality-control plan
- deployment-command.html for operator setup and smoke testing

Internal pages should be locked behind auth before production:
- ae-command.html
- sales-scripts.html
- proposal-builder.html
- employer-portal.html
- government-opportunities.html
- deployment-command.html


Operations/data/vendor expansion:
- operations hub maps employer, candidate, AE, government, proof, and launch workflows
- client welcome packet supports employer onboarding
- vendor packet supports subcontractor/vendor onboarding
- contract vehicles page educates buyers without claiming unverified vehicles
- forms directory maps form routing and owners
- email sequences provide internal follow-up copy
- JSON scaffolds document forms routing, sample job orders, NAICS candidates, and internal pages to lock


Finance/training/risk expansion:
- recruiter-desk.html for internal recruiter workflow
- training-academy.html for AE/recruiter/operator training
- bill-rate-calculator.html for internal estimate math
- timesheet-invoice-control.html for time and billing workflow
- risk-register.html for operational risk tracking
- compliance-posture.html for public compliance posture
- CSV templates for job orders, candidates, clients, government pursuits, and risk register


Sales delivery automation scaffold:
- CRM pipeline page tracks employer account stages.
- Placement tracker page tracks candidate movement.
- Agreement packet organizes legal/contracting document topics.
- Campaign landing pages include urgent staffing, candidate pool, and prime contractor support funnels.
- Data scaffolds include CRM stages, placement stages, campaigns, CSV trackers, and templates.


Local brain layer:
- The site includes a local-first browser assistant called SOL Staffing Local Brain.
- It lives in brain.html and uses brain/brain-corpus.json plus brain/brain.js.
- It can answer staffing questions, route users, provide checklists, provide AE scripts, and enforce safe-claim reminders.
- It uses localStorage for optional browser-local memory.
- It does not call an external AI provider by default.
- It is not a true LLM until connected to a backend/GPU/Ollama/vLLM endpoint.


System overview:
- `system-overview.html` and `SYSTEM_WALKTHROUGH_AND_UPGRADES.md` explain the full staffing site, what works now, what is static, the local brain truth label, production gates, and upgrade roadmap.
- The current site is deployable as a static marketing/content/lead-capture/local-brain system.
- Full live staffing platform behavior requires auth, database, CRM/ATS, secure uploads, email notifications, payroll/insurance/legal operations, and verified government data.
